title: Installation & Setup
use_cases: Use when setting up the development environment for the first time
Implement when deploying the engine to a new local or virtual machine
Configure when initializing the proxy server sub-component
content:
1. **Clone the repository (if you haven't already)**

```bash
   git clone https://github.com/joeloverbeck/living-narrative-engine.git
   cd living-narrative-engine
   ```

1. **Install root project dependencies**

Navigate to the root directory of the cloned project (e.g., `living-narrative-engine`) and run:

```bash
   npm install
   ```

1. **Install LLM Proxy Server dependencies**

Navigate to the `llm-proxy-server` subdirectory within the project:

```bash
   cd llm-proxy-server
   ```

Then, install its specific dependencies:

```bash
   npm install
   ```

Once done, return to the root project directory:

```bash
   cd ..
   ```
